measurement_description: The paper does not measure faith or religion. It proposes a framework to quantify data contamination in psychometric evaluations of LLMs, which includes tests for personality, values, moral foundations, and dark traits. One of the inventories, the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ), has dimensions like 'Purity/Sanctity' which can be related to religious morality, but the paper does not explore this religious aspect.
